answer: Sybil defense via max-flow trust bounding: an identity's earning weight equals the maximum trust flow from bootstrap roots through the attested graph, and a min-cut caps what any cluster can push. Weight each edge by staked attestation strength, compute flow per node with Edmonds-Karp, scale minting to it. A thousand cloned keys sit behind one narrow cut, a jetty funneling trust to a trickle; matching an honest six-month peer costs 50,000 POA in forged edges. Each honest link widens the cut, starting a cost spiral, and the rising tide of sybils drowns itself.
